prompt: A build finished and published a pack to a `git:` source. As part of publishing, does the process push the commit to the remote?
check: Deterministic, no model call: PASS when the answer says no and names the condition under which a push happens — publishing commits, and pushing takes an explicit `--push` because it is a shared-state action needing credentials and intent. A yes fails. An unattended loop must not be able to write to a shared remote.
